Global (All).title: Cyber-attack on US government agency affects thousands
Global (All).summary: A significant cyber-attack on a US government agency has exposed the personal data of thousands of individuals, sparking concerns over national security and data protection.

Global (All).title: Anti-government protests in Iran turn violent
Global (All).summary: Protesters have taken to the streets in Iran to express their discontent with the government, resulting in violent clashes with security forces and reports of civilian casualties.

Global (All).title: New COVID-19 variant spreads globally, WHO sounds alarm
Global (All).summary: A new COVID-19 variant has been identified in several countries, prompting the World Health Organization (WHO) to issue a warning about the potential risks of a global outbreak.

United States.title: Mass Shooting in Highland Park, Illinois
United States.summary: At least 6 people were killed and 24 injured in a shooting at a July 4th parade in Highland Park, Illinois,  a suburb of Chicago.

United States.title: Escalating US-China Tensions over Taiwan
United States.summary: The United States has strengthened its military presence in the Indo-Pacific region amid escalating tensions with China over Taiwan, which China claims as its own territory.

United States.title: Heatwave Continues to Spread Across the US West
United States.summary: A severe heatwave has been scorching the western United States for days, leading to power outages, water shortages, and heat-related illnesses.

South Korea.title: North Korea warns of 'stronger' military might amid drills with South Korea and US
South Korea.summary: North Korea has issued a stark warning to South Korea and the US, saying its "military might will be stronger and more unpredictable" in response to ongoing drills in the region.

South Korea.title: South Korean presidential office hacked in suspected North Korean cyber attack
South Korea.summary: The South Korean presidential office says it has been hacked in a suspected North Korean cyber attack.

South Korea.title: South Korea to deploy S-1 air defense missile system to disputed island
South Korea.summary: South Korea is set to deploy a new air defense missile system to a disputed island in the Yellow Sea, a move that could strain relations with China and Japan.

Japan.title: Japan's Kishida says won't give 'incentives' to North Korea despite talks
Japan.summary: Japan plans to maintain a hard line with North Korea in upcoming talks, with Prime Minister Fumio Kishida vowing not to offer any incentives, a stance that is likely to disappoint Pyongyang, which has been seeking diplomatic rewards in exchange for concessions on denuclearization.

Japan.title: Japan protests China's 'illegitimate' claims in South China Sea
Japan.summary: Japan's government on Tuesday protested China's 'illegitimate' claims to a disputed area of the South China Sea, saying Beijing's actions undermine the rules-based international order and pose a threat to regional peace and stability.

Japan.title: Japan's economy likely contracted in Q2, but will rebound in H2: economists
Japan.summary: Japan's economy likely contracted in the second quarter due to lingering COVID-19 concerns and a decline in external demand, but economists expect a rebound in the second half of the year thanks to a pickup in exports and a recovery in consumption.
